assembly_md:
Morning Assembly is conducted by one particular class for the whole week. It is held on Mondays, Wednesdays and Fridays. On Mondays and Wednesdays it is held in English and on Fridays in Telugu / Hindi / Sanskrit.

The Morning Assembly begins with ‘Vande Mataram’ and is followed by prayers, then mass PT, Patriotic Song, Scripture, Reading News, Speeches, Recitation of Poetry, a few creative demonstrations, and ends with the ‘National Anthem’. This provides the school with an excellent opportunity to develop the overall personality of the students and helps them shed their stage fear.
council_md: The Student Council of DPS Visakhapatnam includes the Senior School council, House Prefects and Vice House Prefects, installed at the annual Investiture Ceremony.
rids_md:
DPS Visakhapatnam has been recognised by the British Council under the **Recognition of an International Dimension in Schools (RIDS) 2026–2029** — a mark of the school’s commitment to global citizenship.

Our International Policy: to encourage young minds to develop understanding, tolerance and appreciation of the diverse cultures of the world, and to nurture global citizens who play a responsible role for sustainable development in a changing world.
